page.overview:
Who is Giant Eagle?

The is the personal summon of Gennō, and hails from the Land of Mountains.

This giant eagle has white fur around its body and purple fur around its head and neck, outer wings and tail. It also wears a light blue-coloured strap around its neck, It wears a greyish-coloured plane pilots hat on its head and it also has a yellow beak.

It could fly very fast and smoothly, it was also able to dodge a giant rock being thrown at it by Sakura in mid-air.

Genno summoned it to throw back the plans that he stole for the head carpenter, and later to help him fight Naruto and his teammates. Naruto tried to land a Rasengan on it, but Shikamaru ordered Hinata to use her Byakugan and help Naruto time the jump. Naruto missed, but Sakura threw a large rock at the bird, forcing the bird to dodge, which allowed Naruto to land the hit and the bird was sent flying in the air.
